title: Software Developer
description: Designs, writes, tests and maintains application software for web, desktop or internal business systems.

title: Web Developer
description: Builds and maintains websites and web applications, front end and back end.

title: Mobile App Developer
description: Builds and ships Android and iOS applications, often cross-platform.

title: QA Engineer / Software Tester
description: Plans and runs tests, finds defects, and builds automated test suites.

title: Data Analyst
description: Turns business data into reports, dashboards and decisions for managers.

title: Data Scientist
description: Builds statistical and machine-learning models and designs experiments.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Takes models to production: pipelines, training infrastructure, serving and monitoring.

title: Data Entry Clerk
description: Keys paper or scanned records into spreadsheets and internal systems accurately.

title: Customer Support Representative
description: Handles customer questions and complaints by chat, email, phone or social media.

title: Call Center / BPO Agent
description: Makes or receives high volumes of calls for sales, surveys or support, often on a script.

title: Accountant
description: Records transactions, prepares statements, handles tax and supports audits.

title: Bank Officer
description: Serves customers at a branch, processes accounts, loans and compliance checks.

title: Financial Analyst
description: Builds models, analyses performance and supports investment or planning decisions.

title: Graphic Designer
description: Produces visual assets for print, social media, advertising and branding.

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Researches users, designs interfaces and prototypes, and hands off to developers.

title: Content Writer
description: Writes articles, web copy, scripts and social content, often SEO-optimised.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description: Plans and runs paid and organic campaigns across search, social and email.

title: Apparel Merchandiser (RMG)
description: Liaises between international buyers and factories: costing, sampling and shipment follow-up.

title: Garments Production Supervisor
description: Runs a sewing floor: line balancing, output targets, quality and worker supervision.

title: School Teacher (Secondary)
description: Teaches a subject, plans lessons, assesses students and manages a classroom.

title: Civil Engineer
description: Designs and supervises buildings, roads and water infrastructure on site and in the office.

title: Electrical Engineer
description: Designs, installs and maintains electrical systems, power distribution and controls.

title: HR Officer
description: Recruits, onboards, supports employees and keeps HR records and compliance in order.

title: Sales Executive
description: Finds and wins customers: prospecting, meetings, negotiation and account growth.

title: Project Coordinator
description: Keeps projects on schedule: planning, chasing owners, reporting and documentation.

title: Translator (English–Bangla)
description: Translates documents, subtitles and website content between English and Bangla.

title: Network / System Administrator
description: Keeps office networks, servers and user accounts running and secure.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Monitors threats, investigates incidents and hardens systems against attack.

title: Supply Chain / Logistics Coordinator
description: Coordinates purchasing, inventory, warehousing and delivery so goods arrive on time.

title: NGO Field Officer
description: Delivers programme activities in communities: mobilisation, training, data and reporting.

title: Journalist / Reporter
description: Finds, verifies and writes stories for print, online or broadcast.

title: Research Assistant
description: Supports studies: literature, data collection, cleaning, analysis and write-up.
